unbounded_control.message:
Out of Memory Error: failed to allocate data of size 16.0 MiB (479.1 MiB/488.2 MiB used)

Possible solutions:
* Reducing the number of threads (SET threads=X)
* Disabling insertion-order preservation (SET preserve_insertion_order=false)
* Increasing the memory limit (SET memory_limit='...GB')

See also https://duckdb.org/docs/stable/guides/performance/how_to_tune_workloads

limitations: Same row counts are not the same real payloads, candidate distribution, full run or identity accuracy.
